body:
# Effect Giver
This Data Pack adds a button named "Effect Giver" to the pause menu that lets you apply effects to yourself. It is really easy to use.
![Effect Giver Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a27d8132db06695586b9658636fae09c366395b7.gif)
## Options
**You can configure:**
- The target
- The effect
- The time
- The amplifier
- The particles

You can also clear effects
